m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md), then docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md + GLOSSARY.md if present, plus the g1-implement handoff and PRE_REGISTRATION.md / PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md. Verify handoff completeness (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + handoff + pre-registration + problem statement loaded; handoff complete

m1-join-design.title: Verify DB schemas + design join (no code yet beyond exploration)
m1-join-design.imperative: Confirm exact schemas/signatures from source (not guessed): session_estimates columns (physics_estimates.db), sessions/lap_times/session_classifications columns (f1_data_<year>.db), and the reference pace-gap formula (compute_pace_gaps / build_quali_pace_gap_history in src/evo_predictor/quali_pace_gap_history.py). Resolve the constructor<->team name mismatch (session_estimates constructor names vs session_classifications team names) with a verified per-year alias/containment matching scheme -- document the scheme. Attest c1 once verified against live DB queries (not just source reading).

postconditions.statement: schemas + pace-gap formula + team/constructor alias scheme verified against live DB reads

constraints: cite exact seam signatures from source before using them

m2-script-run.title: Build scripts/g1_correlation_screen.py and produce a real run
m2-script-run.imperative: Write scripts/g1_correlation_screen.py: pure DB/pandas, absolute paths into C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/, computes actual_pace_gap/recent_history_baseline/quali_error per (year,round,driver), broadcasts constructor physics axes onto drivers, computes primary axis (lateral_total_grip_g) Pearson+Spearman+n+95%CI plus the 9 secondary axes + power_to_drag composite (clearly labeled secondary). Prints join-stage row counts. Run it standalone from cwd C:/Programs/f1-624 and capture full stdout.

postconditions.statement: py scripts/g1_correlation_screen.py runs from repo root, exit 0, prints headline result + join-stage row counts

m3-findings-check.title: Write G1_FINDINGS.md and implement --check
m3-findings-check.imperative: Write .agent-work/624-phase0/G1_FINDINGS.md (method recap, primary result n/coef/CI, full 11-axis+composite table, honest read per critic disposition F7, explicit broadcast-simplification note). Record the headline numbers in a machine-parseable line the script itself parses. Implement --check in the script: re-run analysis, compare recomputed headline to the recorded value, exit 0 on match else 1. Verify.

postconditions.statement: py scripts/g1_correlation_screen.py --check exits 0 and reproduces the recorded headline

constraints: G1_FINDINGS.md is local-only, never committed on the mission branch
primary axis is NOT re-derived after seeing the number

m4-evidence-package.title: Deliverable-path checks, evidence, IMPLEMENTER_RESULT
m4-evidence-package.imperative: Confirm git check-ignore exits 1 for scripts/g1_correlation_screen.py (not gitignored). Capture git status/diff --stat showing exactly the two new files. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md and send it. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: git check-ignore confirms script tracked; git status/diff --stat captured; IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md written
